observations: Photo 0 shows a large office photocopier wrapped in clear plastic with 'SHARP AR-M207' visible on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the right side of the wrapped machine with a 'digital' logo and paper trays marked A4 and A3.
Photo 2 shows another angle of the same wrapped machine with 'SHARP AR-M207' visible on the front.
A watermark reads 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the images.
The plastic wrapping obscures the control panel, scanner glass, and much of the exterior condition.

claims.evidence: No origin markings, import documents, or labels visible in the photos.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show 'AR-M207' on the machine.

claims.claim: Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Marketing language that cannot be verified from static photos of a wrapped machine.

risks.risk: The photocopier may not power on or produce copies.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powering on, running a test copy, and showing any error codes.

risks.risk: The 'London use' origin cannot be confirmed; it may be locally used or refurbished.
risks.proof: Import documents, original purchase receipt, or verifiable service history.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage to the scanner glass, document feeder, or exterior under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the scanner glass, document feeder, and exterior without plastic wrap.

risks.risk: Toner, drum, and page count are unknown; consumables may be near end of life.
risks.proof: A photo or screenshot of the machine's page counter/total count.

proof_requests: Video of the photocopier powering on and producing a copy.
Close-up photos of the scanner glass and document feeder without plastic wrap.
Photo of the machine's page counter or total count.
Any import or purchase documents supporting the 'London use' claim.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sharp AR-M207 photocopier from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working) pending proof of function.
